exposure: GDM status (CoMC vs. standard hospital care)
finding: Women with GDM who received CoMC were significantly more likely to experience spontaneous onset of labor, labor without an epidural, and exclusively breastfeed.
mod_finding: Women with gestational diabetes who received continuity of midwifery care were significantly more likely to experience spontaneous onset of labor, labor without an epidural, and exclusively breastfeed.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
